description: Graded synthetic benchmark for the Kontur pipeline (lift -> validate -> transpile -> render). Supported cases are scored on round-trip fidelity (lift -> transpile -> lift -> transpile is a fixed point). Unsupported cases must be rejected loudly by the lifter (fail-closed, never silently lose code).

cases.title: Single print effect
cases.note: Simplest leaf: one console.log on the control wire, no params, no return.

cases.title: Pure arithmetic with tail return
cases.note: Two params, one binary op, single tail return -> a data-only module.

cases.title: Sequenced stub-call pipeline
cases.note: let bindings of unknown calls become sequenced function nodes; node ids preserve the local names.

cases.title: Counted for-loop
cases.note: Inclusive counted loop with a print body; the loop carries the control wire through to done.

cases.title: Top-level if/else (no returns in arms)
cases.note: Probes branch-as-terminal lowering: both arms print. A top-level branch dead-ends control, so the module has no done out-port.

cases.title: FizzBuzz
cases.note: The canonical example, authored as source: loop, 3-deep nested branch, four print effects.

cases.title: Multi-module call graph
cases.note: Two functions; calls to the sibling become module-link nodes. Exercises the multi-canvas hyperlink renderer.

cases.title: Python counted loop
cases.note: Exercises the Python lifter (real ast module) and range(from, to + 1) inverse lowering.

cases.title: Python multi-module call graph
cases.note: Python sibling calls become module links; round-trips through the Python backend.

cases.title: Class with attribute + methods
cases.note: A class lifts to a module of kind "class": a `state` cell for the attribute and a method-link per method. Methods read/write state via stateGet/stateSet. Descend a method link to see its flow.

cases.title: Python class with attribute + methods
cases.note: Same class model through the Python backend: `self.attr` access, methods drop the implicit self, round-trips.

cases.title: Template string interpolation
cases.note: A template literal lowers to a `concat` chain over its string parts and interpolations — the IR's string-join op, emitted as `+` in every backend. No new node kind needed.

cases.title: Condition-driven while loop
cases.note: A `while` node — the condition-driven sibling of the counted `loop`: one data-in `cond`, control-out `body`/`done`. The back-edge is implicit, like the counted loop.

cases.title: Ternary expression
cases.note: A ternary lowers to a `select` node — a pure data multiplexer (cond/then/else → value), the data-wire analogue of the control-wire `branch` (Blueprints' Select node).

cases.title: Return inside both branch arms
cases.note: A tail if/else whose arms each return is normalized to a single `return select(cond, then, else)` — branch-arm returns become one representable data multiplexer instead of multiple control exits.

cases.title: In-place reassignment (n += 1)
cases.note: Single-assignment dataflow: a reassignment is not a node but an SSA-style rebind of the name to a fresh data source. `n += 1; print(n)` round-trips to `print(n + 1)`.

cases.title: Array / list literal
cases.note: An array literal lowers to an `array` node — a pure list constructor with one data-in pin per element. Backends emit `[…]`.

cases.title: Python list comprehension
cases.note: A range comprehension lowers to a `comprehension` node — range bounds + a bound `index` + an element expression that reads it. Emitted as a Python comprehension and a TS range-map.

cases.title: try/catch protected block
cases.note: A try/catch lowers to a `try` node — control-out `body`/`catch`/`done` plus a data-out `error` for the caught binding (catch-all semantics; the IR models no exception type). Emitted as TS try/catch and Python try/except.

cases.title: throw (unsupported statement)
cases.note: Catching is now modelled, but RAISING is non-local control flow the IR deliberately has no node for; `throw`/`raise` must be refused, not approximated. Keeps the fail-closed (reject) path under test.
